units.id: mission:Discover Hostile Quarg|log|280|0
units.english: The Gegno are a humanoid species to the galactic east of the core. According to the Quarg, they are split between the Vi and the Scin, and are not interested in interaction with outsider species.
units.italian: I Gegno sono una specie umanoide a est del nucleo galattico. Secondo i Quarg si dividono tra Vi e Scin e non sono interessati a interagire con specie estranee.

units.id: mission:Discover Hostile Quarg|As soon as you enter the system, your eyes are greeted with a familiar sight - a Quarg Ringworld. Shortly after, the Quarg open a communications channel with you. "Your welcome is not desired here, aggressor. What purpose do you seek, if not that of violence?"|282|0
units.english: As soon as you enter the system, your eyes are greeted with a familiar sight - a Quarg Ringworld. Shortly after, the Quarg open a communications channel with you. "Your welcome is not desired here, aggressor. What purpose do you seek, if not that of violence?"
units.italian: Appena entri nel sistema i tuoi occhi incontrano una vista familiare: un anello dei Quarg. Poco dopo i Quarg aprono un canale di comunicazione. "La tua presenza non è gradita qui, aggressore. Quale scopo persegui, se non la violenza?"

units.id: mission:Discover Hostile Quarg|	"The aliens on a nearby world sent me to you."|284|0
units.english: "The aliens on a nearby world sent me to you."
units.italian: "Gli alieni di un mondo vicino mi hanno mandato da voi."

units.id: mission:Discover Hostile Quarg|	"I would like help in conversing with the nearby aliens."|286|0
units.english: "I would like help in conversing with the nearby aliens."
units.italian: "Vorrei aiuto per conversare con gli alieni qui vicino."

units.id: mission:Discover Hostile Quarg|	The Quarg are quick to respond. "You will find no such help in us. It would be of best interest to not affiliate yourself with these aliens, whom call themselves the Gegno. It is not us, so much as it is the Gegno, that do not desire contact. Little would you understand how impactful your actions may be with ether the Vi or Scin, let alone ones of violence." A slight pause ensues. "Now, begone from our system. We shall be watching."|287|0
units.english: The Quarg are quick to respond. "You will find no such help in us. It would be of best interest to not affiliate yourself with these aliens, whom call themselves the Gegno. It is not us, so much as it is the Gegno, that do not desire contact. Little would you understand how impactful your actions may be with ether the Vi or Scin, let alone ones of violence." A slight pause ensues. "Now, begone from our system. We shall be watching."
units.italian: I Quarg rispondono in fretta. "Non troverai un aiuto simile in noi. Sarebbe nel tuo interesse non affiliarti a questi alieni, che si fanno chiamare Gegno. Non siamo noi, quanto piuttosto i Gegno, a non desiderare il contatto. Poco capiresti di quanto le tue azioni possano pesare sui Vi o sugli Scin, figurarsi quelle violente." Segue una breve pausa. "Ora vattene dal nostro sistema. Ti osserveremo."

units.id: mission:Discover Hostile Quarg|	Without the Quarg's help, interaction with these so-called "Gegno" seems unlikely for the foreseeable future.|288|0
units.english: Without the Quarg's help, interaction with these so-called "Gegno" seems unlikely for the foreseeable future.
units.italian: Senza l'aiuto dei Quarg, interagire con questi sedicenti "Gegno" sembra improbabile nel prossimo futuro.

units.id: mission:Discover Hostile Quarg|label|291|0
units.english: sent
units.italian: sent

units.id: mission:Discover Hostile Quarg|	After an extensive moment of silence, the Quarg respond. "We have no interest in aiding an instigator. The aliens you speak of, Gegno as they are called, are a fragile species. They themselves do not desire contact, as their attention is had on the great deal of internal struggle between the Scin and Vi. In such a case, the Gegno would gain nothing in relations with interstellar warmongers, and you are strongly cautioned to avoid affiliation with them. Now, begone from our system. We shall be watching."|292|0
units.english: After an extensive moment of silence, the Quarg respond. "We have no interest in aiding an instigator. The aliens you speak of, Gegno as they are called, are a fragile species. They themselves do not desire contact, as their attention is had on the great deal of internal struggle between the Scin and Vi. In such a case, the Gegno would gain nothing in relations with interstellar warmongers, and you are strongly cautioned to avoid affiliation with them. Now, begone from our system. We shall be watching."
units.italian: Dopo un lungo silenzio i Quarg rispondono. "Non abbiamo alcun interesse ad aiutare un sobillatore. Gli alieni di cui parli, chiamati Gegno, sono una specie fragile. Sono loro a non desiderare il contatto, perché la loro attenzione è presa dal grande conflitto interno tra Scin e Vi. In tal caso i Gegno non guadagnerebbero nulla da rapporti con dei guerrafondai interstellari, e ti si raccomanda caldamente di evitare di affiliarti a loro. Ora vattene dal nostro sistema. Ti osserveremo."

units.id: mission:Discover Hostile Quarg|	Without the Quarg's help, interaction with these so-called "Gegno" seems unlikely for the foreseeable future.|293|0
units.english: Without the Quarg's help, interaction with these so-called "Gegno" seems unlikely for the foreseeable future.
units.italian: Senza l'aiuto dei Quarg, interagire con questi sedicenti "Gegno" sembra improbabile nel prossimo futuro.

units.id: mission:Giaru Gegno: Quarg Contact|log|301|0
units.english: The Gegno are a humanoid species to the galactic east of the core, split amongst themselves into branches. One branch is the Gegno Vi, who are spoken of to be strong and forceful brutes. The other is the Gegno Scin, mentioned to be progressers of research and technology. Apart from them, a majority of the Gegno's population consists of complacent civilians.
units.italian: I Gegno sono una specie umanoide a est del nucleo galattico, divisa al proprio interno in rami. Un ramo è quello dei Gegno Vi, descritti come bruti forti e prepotenti. L'altro è quello dei Gegno Scin, detti cultori della ricerca e della tecnologia. A parte loro, la maggior parte della popolazione Gegno è fatta di civili indifferenti.

units.id: mission:Giaru Gegno: Quarg Contact|log|302|0
units.english: Learned from the Quarg that the Gegno are not interested in interaction with outsider species.
units.italian: Ho saputo dai Quarg che i Gegno non sono interessati a interagire con specie estranee.

units.id: mission:Giaru Gegno: Quarg Contact|	The Quarg here move in an unusually quiet and eerie manner. They are dismissive of the other species walking about, who are equally as dismissive of you. The strange atmosphere is eventually broken when a few Quarg start to advance towards you, moving much quicker than the rest. After some unidentifiable discussion and gestures between themselves, one of them motions you to follow them.|309|0
units.english: The Quarg here move in an unusually quiet and eerie manner. They are dismissive of the other species walking about, who are equally as dismissive of you. The strange atmosphere is eventually broken when a few Quarg start to advance towards you, moving much quicker than the rest. After some unidentifiable discussion and gestures between themselves, one of them motions you to follow them.
units.italian: I Quarg qui si muovono in modo insolitamente silenzioso e inquietante. Ignorano le altre specie che camminano intorno, che a loro volta ignorano te. L'atmosfera strana si rompe quando alcuni Quarg cominciano ad avanzare verso di te, molto più in fretta degli altri. Dopo una discussione e alcuni gesti incomprensibili tra loro, uno ti fa cenno di seguirlo.

units.id: mission:Giaru Gegno: Quarg Contact|label|312|0
units.english: has met gegno
units.italian: has met gegno

units.id: mission:Giaru Gegno: Quarg Contact|The visual of a complete Quarg Ringworld is drastically different than the alien homeworld you were on before. Such a pristine, advanced structure is quite the opposite of a disorderly industrial civilization. The population of Quarg here must be in the trillions, many times more than the population of the alien homeworld. What's even more interesting is that there are aliens of the kind you met before are here on the ring too. The Quarg must have some kind of relations with them, perhaps through trade, maintenance, or other services. Despite their presence, both they and the Quarg seem to be dismissive of one another. However, a few of the aliens occasionally glance over at you in some form of curiosity.|316|0
units.english: The visual of a complete Quarg Ringworld is drastically different than the alien homeworld you were on before. Such a pristine, advanced structure is quite the opposite of a disorderly industrial civilization. The population of Quarg here must be in the trillions, many times more than the population of the alien homeworld. What's even more interesting is that there are aliens of the kind you met before are here on the ring too. The Quarg must have some kind of relations with them, perhaps through trade, maintenance, or other services. Despite their presence, both they and the Quarg seem to be dismissive of one another. However, a few of the aliens occasionally glance over at you in some form of curiosity.
units.italian: L'aspetto di un anello dei Quarg completo è molto diverso dal mondo natale alieno su cui sei stato prima. Una struttura così integra e avanzata è l'esatto contrario di una civiltà industriale disordinata. La popolazione di Quarg qui deve contare migliaia di miliardi, molte volte quella del mondo natale alieno. Ancora più interessante è che sull'anello ci sono anche alieni del tipo che hai già incontrato. I Quarg devono avere qualche rapporto con loro, forse di commercio, manutenzione o altri servizi. Nonostante la presenza, sia loro sia i Quarg sembrano ignorarsi. Qualcuno degli alieni, però, ogni tanto ti lancia un'occhiata incuriosita.

units.id: mission:Giaru Gegno: Quarg Contact|	Soon enough, a few Quarg start to rush towards you much faster than the others and begin a conversation between themselves. You aren't sure what language they are speaking, but judging by the tones and pronunciations, it sounds similar to the one you've heard the aliens speaking before. After a moment or so, one of them motions you to follow them.|320|0
units.english: Soon enough, a few Quarg start to rush towards you much faster than the others and begin a conversation between themselves. You aren't sure what language they are speaking, but judging by the tones and pronunciations, it sounds similar to the one you've heard the aliens speaking before. After a moment or so, one of them motions you to follow them.
units.italian: In breve alcuni Quarg si precipitano verso di te molto più in fretta degli altri e cominciano a parlare tra loro. Non sai che lingua usino, ma dai toni e dalla pronuncia sembra simile a quella che hai sentito parlare dagli alieni. Dopo un momento uno di loro ti fa cenno di seguirlo.

units.id: mission:Giaru Gegno: Quarg Contact|label|322|0
units.english: walking
units.italian: walking

units.id: mission:Giaru Gegno: Quarg Contact|	You walk with the Quarg, occasionally having trouble keeping pace with their silent yet brisk steps, as you head towards an area that appears devoid of the other aliens. Eventually, you are led to a smaller room with two more Quarg in waiting, silently sitting at the end of it. They talk, but this time you can hear a few familiar sounding terms, one being "Huema." Despite speaking to each other for several minutes, the Quarg still look at each other in what you assume is something like bewilderment.|323|0
units.english: You walk with the Quarg, occasionally having trouble keeping pace with their silent yet brisk steps, as you head towards an area that appears devoid of the other aliens. Eventually, you are led to a smaller room with two more Quarg in waiting, silently sitting at the end of it. They talk, but this time you can hear a few familiar sounding terms, one being "Huema." Despite speaking to each other for several minutes, the Quarg still look at each other in what you assume is something like bewilderment.
units.italian: Cammini con il Quarg, a volte in difficoltà a tenere il passo dei suoi passi silenziosi e svelti, dirigendoti verso una zona che sembra priva degli altri alieni. Alla fine sei portato in una stanza più piccola, dove altri due Quarg aspettano seduti in silenzio in fondo. Parlano, ma stavolta senti qualche termine che ti suona familiare, uno dei quali è "Huema". Nonostante parlino tra loro per diversi minuti, i Quarg continuano a guardarsi con quella che supponi essere perplessità.

units.id: mission:Giaru Gegno: Quarg Contact|	One of the Quarg waiting in the room finally turns towards you and motions you to take a seat. Its look of confusion disappears when they turn their gaze back upon you. Meanwhile, the other Quarg that was seated has left the room, along with the ones that first brought you here.|324|0
units.english: One of the Quarg waiting in the room finally turns towards you and motions you to take a seat. Its look of confusion disappears when they turn their gaze back upon you. Meanwhile, the other Quarg that was seated has left the room, along with the ones that first brought you here.
units.italian: Uno dei Quarg in attesa si volta finalmente verso di te e ti fa cenno di sederti. La sua espressione confusa scompare quando posa di nuovo lo sguardo su di te. Intanto l'altro Quarg seduto ha lasciato la stanza, insieme a quelli che ti hanno portato qui.

units.id: mission:Giaru Gegno: Quarg Contact|	"Is there a problem?"|326|0
units.english: "Is there a problem?"
units.italian: "C'è un problema?"

units.id: mission:Giaru Gegno: Quarg Contact|	The Quarg continues to look at you and bows its head slightly in an apologetic manner, as it seems neither it, nor any other Quarg on this ringworld, can speak your language. You continue to patiently wait in the uneasy silence, withholding your curiosities as almost half an hour goes by.|327|0
units.english: The Quarg continues to look at you and bows its head slightly in an apologetic manner, as it seems neither it, nor any other Quarg on this ringworld, can speak your language. You continue to patiently wait in the uneasy silence, withholding your curiosities as almost half an hour goes by.
units.italian: Il Quarg continua a guardarti e china appena il capo in modo scusante: sembra che né lui né nessun altro Quarg dell'anello sappia parlare la tua lingua. Continui ad aspettare con pazienza nel silenzio teso, trattenendo la curiosità, mentre passa quasi mezz'ora.

units.id: mission:Giaru Gegno: Quarg Contact|	Finally, the silence is broken when the second Quarg from earlier enters the room again. This time, it glares at you much more energetically, and you begin to wonder if your presence really is an issue.|328|0
units.english: Finally, the silence is broken when the second Quarg from earlier enters the room again. This time, it glares at you much more energetically, and you begin to wonder if your presence really is an issue.
units.italian: Alla fine il silenzio si rompe: il secondo Quarg di prima rientra nella stanza. Stavolta ti fissa con molta più energia, e cominci a chiederti se la tua presenza sia davvero un problema.

units.id: mission:Giaru Gegno: Quarg Contact|	You preemptively begin to stand up, but you are cut short when you see the second Quarg raise its arms outward in a gesture you never thought you'd see from a Quarg. "This must be for you an exhilarating day, young traverser. I strongly imagine this is a first for both of us." It is now obvious that this Quarg is not the same one from earlier, and you begin to see a few differences in its attire and figure. The upbeat rhythm to their speech is not something you would expect of a Quarg.|333|0
units.english: You preemptively begin to stand up, but you are cut short when you see the second Quarg raise its arms outward in a gesture you never thought you'd see from a Quarg. "This must be for you an exhilarating day, young traverser. I strongly imagine this is a first for both of us." It is now obvious that this Quarg is not the same one from earlier, and you begin to see a few differences in its attire and figure. The upbeat rhythm to their speech is not something you would expect of a Quarg.
units.italian: Ti alzi in anticipo, ma ti blocchi quando vedi il secondo Quarg allargare le braccia in un gesto che non avresti mai immaginato di vedere da un Quarg. "Questa deve essere per te una giornata esaltante, giovane viaggiatore. Immagino fortemente che sia una prima volta per entrambi." Ora è ovvio che questo Quarg non è quello di prima, e cominci a notare qualche differenza nell'abbigliamento e nella figura. Il ritmo vivace del parlato non è quello che ti aspetteresti da un Quarg.

units.id: mission:Giaru Gegno: Quarg Contact|	"Where am I?"|335|0
units.english: "Where am I?"
units.italian: "Dove sono?"

units.id: mission:Giaru Gegno: Quarg Contact|	The Quarg sits down across from you, still gesturing its arms about in a strange manner, albeit slower this time. "You have found yourself in the dwelling of the mighty Gegno, who have rooted their hardy empire here in the great galactic east."|336|0
units.english: The Quarg sits down across from you, still gesturing its arms about in a strange manner, albeit slower this time. "You have found yourself in the dwelling of the mighty Gegno, who have rooted their hardy empire here in the great galactic east."
units.italian: Il Quarg si siede di fronte a te, continuando ad agitare le braccia in modo strano, anche se più lentamente. "Ti trovi nella dimora dei possenti Gegno, che hanno radicato il loro impero tenace qui, nel grande est galattico."

units.id: mission:Giaru Gegno: Quarg Contact|label|339|0
units.english: intrigued quarg
units.italian: intrigued quarg

units.id: mission:Giaru Gegno: Quarg Contact|	"You have astonishingly achieved a wondrous feat, brave traverser," the Quarg says, placing its hands together. It seems that the Quarg are already aware of your encounter on the alien homeworld. In fact, thinking back to it, the looks of interest earlier by other aliens suggests that the word got spread quickly. It then sits down across from you, then raises its arms outward in a gesture you never thought you'd see from a Quarg. "Not significantly often it is that the mighty Gegno interact with daring outsiders."|340|0
units.english: "You have astonishingly achieved a wondrous feat, brave traverser," the Quarg says, placing its hands together. It seems that the Quarg are already aware of your encounter on the alien homeworld. In fact, thinking back to it, the looks of interest earlier by other aliens suggests that the word got spread quickly. It then sits down across from you, then raises its arms outward in a gesture you never thought you'd see from a Quarg. "Not significantly often it is that the mighty Gegno interact with daring outsiders."
units.italian: "Hai compiuto in modo sorprendente un'impresa meravigliosa, coraggioso viaggiatore", dice il Quarg, unendo le mani. Sembra che i Quarg siano già al corrente del tuo incontro sul mondo natale alieno. Ripensandoci, le occhiate interessate degli altri alieni di prima suggeriscono che la notizia si sia sparsa in fretta. Poi si siede di fronte a te e allarga le braccia in un gesto che non avresti mai immaginato di vedere da un Quarg. "Non è con frequenza significativa che i possenti Gegno interagiscono con audaci estranei."

units.id: mission:Giaru Gegno: Quarg Contact|label|342|0
units.english: the gegno
units.italian: the gegno

units.id: mission:Giaru Gegno: Quarg Contact|	"The Gegno?"|344|0
units.english: "The Gegno?"
units.italian: "I Gegno?"

units.id: mission:Giaru Gegno: Quarg Contact|	"Do the ships I've seen around belong to these Gegno?"|346|0
units.english: "Do the ships I've seen around belong to these Gegno?"
units.italian: "Le navi che ho visto in giro appartengono a questi Gegno?"

units.id: mission:Giaru Gegno: Quarg Contact|	"Yes, the imperious Gegno. A juvenile race, they are, many decades younger than that of you humans. They do not find themselves in the struggle of leadership the same way as others do. Rather, they glorify their pursuit of guidance between one another to share a noble future." You wonder if the Quarg's use of boastful adjectives is because of gaps in its translations, or if it is intentionally speaking that way. Its voice still comes from the lower tones of Quarg speech, clashing with the excited pace it is speaking at.|349|0
units.english: "Yes, the imperious Gegno. A juvenile race, they are, many decades younger than that of you humans. They do not find themselves in the struggle of leadership the same way as others do. Rather, they glorify their pursuit of guidance between one another to share a noble future." You wonder if the Quarg's use of boastful adjectives is because of gaps in its translations, or if it is intentionally speaking that way. Its voice still comes from the lower tones of Quarg speech, clashing with the excited pace it is speaking at.
units.italian: "Sì, gli imperiosi Gegno. Una razza giovane, sono, molte decadi più giovane di voi umani. Non si trovano nella lotta per la guida come gli altri. Piuttosto, glorificano la loro ricerca di una guida reciproca per condividere un futuro nobile." Ti chiedi se l'uso di aggettivi vanagloriosi da parte del Quarg dipenda da lacune nella traduzione o se parli così di proposito. La sua voce viene comunque dai toni bassi del parlato Quarg, in contrasto con il ritmo eccitato.

units.id: mission:Giaru Gegno: Quarg Contact|	"What is this guidance they pursue?"|351|0
units.english: "What is this guidance they pursue?"
units.italian: "Qual è questa guida che perseguono?"

units.id: mission:Giaru Gegno: Quarg Contact|	"Indeed, the vessels of such stature represent the robust Gegno. Not in sorrow, but greatness do they pursue their future, bearing the fruit of sacrifice as a trophy to their name."|354|0
units.english: "Indeed, the vessels of such stature represent the robust Gegno. Not in sorrow, but greatness do they pursue their future, bearing the fruit of sacrifice as a trophy to their name."
units.italian: "Certo, i vascelli di tale statura rappresentano i robusti Gegno. Non nel dolore, ma nella grandezza perseguono il loro futuro, portando il frutto del sacrificio come trofeo al proprio nome."

units.id: mission:Giaru Gegno: Quarg Contact|	"Sacrifice?"|356|0
units.english: "Sacrifice?"
units.italian: "Sacrificio?"

units.id: mission:Giaru Gegno: Quarg Contact|	"The Gegno believe it necessary to pursue what they choose must be, in order to imagine a grand future for themselves. Thus, they have separated into two different branches. One brandishes themselves as the honorable Vi - mightiest of warriors, toughest of kin. They are brutes that see proof of strength being the one and only variable in determining their path. That of the Scin, the more technologically able, believe that only through progression of sciences and discovery will the Gegno prosper."|359|0
units.english: "The Gegno believe it necessary to pursue what they choose must be, in order to imagine a grand future for themselves. Thus, they have separated into two different branches. One brandishes themselves as the honorable Vi - mightiest of warriors, toughest of kin. They are brutes that see proof of strength being the one and only variable in determining their path. That of the Scin, the more technologically able, believe that only through progression of sciences and discovery will the Gegno prosper."
units.italian: "I Gegno ritengono necessario perseguire ciò che scelgono che debba essere, per immaginare un futuro grandioso. Così si sono separati in due rami diversi. Uno si fregia del nome di onorevoli Vi: i più potenti dei guerrieri, i più duri dei consanguinei. Sono bruti che vedono la prova della forza come l'unica variabile nel determinare il proprio cammino. Quello degli Scin, più capaci in tecnologia, crede che solo con il progresso delle scienze e della scoperta i Gegno prospereranno."

units.id: mission:Giaru Gegno: Quarg Contact|	"The Gegno believe it necessary to overwhelmingly sacrifice whatever must be, in order to imagine a future for themselves. Thus, they have separated into two different branches. One brandishes themselves as the honorable Vi - mightiest of warriors, toughest of kin. They are brutes that see proof of strength being the one and only variable in determining their path. That of the Scin, the more technologically able, believe that only through progression of sciences and discovery will the Gegno prosper."|362|0
units.english: "The Gegno believe it necessary to overwhelmingly sacrifice whatever must be, in order to imagine a future for themselves. Thus, they have separated into two different branches. One brandishes themselves as the honorable Vi - mightiest of warriors, toughest of kin. They are brutes that see proof of strength being the one and only variable in determining their path. That of the Scin, the more technologically able, believe that only through progression of sciences and discovery will the Gegno prosper."
units.italian: "I Gegno ritengono necessario sacrificare in modo soverchiante tutto ciò che deve essere, per immaginare un futuro per sé. Così si sono separati in due rami diversi. Uno si fregia del nome di onorevoli Vi: i più potenti dei guerrieri, i più duri dei consanguinei. Sono bruti che vedono la prova della forza come l'unica variabile nel determinare il proprio cammino. Quello degli Scin, più capaci in tecnologia, crede che solo con il progresso delle scienze e della scoperta i Gegno prospereranno."

units.id: mission:Giaru Gegno: Quarg Contact|	"The Vi are right, the strength to survive is more important than anything else."|365|0
units.english: "The Vi are right, the strength to survive is more important than anything else."
units.italian: "I Vi hanno ragione, la forza di sopravvivere conta più di ogni altra cosa."

units.id: mission:Giaru Gegno: Quarg Contact|	"The Scin are right, technological advancement opens up so many possibilities."|367|0
units.english: "The Scin are right, technological advancement opens up so many possibilities."
units.italian: "Gli Scin hanno ragione, il progresso tecnologico apre così tante possibilità."

units.id: mission:Giaru Gegno: Quarg Contact|	"Why do they not combine their efforts to better their future together?"|369|0
units.english: "Why do they not combine their efforts to better their future together?"
units.italian: "Perché non uniscono i loro sforzi per migliorare insieme il loro futuro?"

units.id: mission:Giaru Gegno: Quarg Contact|	"While it is characteristic, such a tremendous proposition is rather dull for a marvelously growing species. Be that as it may, you humans follow this harsh doctrine, though to a much lesser degree than that of the Vi."|372|0
units.english: "While it is characteristic, such a tremendous proposition is rather dull for a marvelously growing species. Be that as it may, you humans follow this harsh doctrine, though to a much lesser degree than that of the Vi."
units.italian: "Per quanto sia caratteristico, una proposta così imponente è piuttosto noiosa per una specie che cresce in modo meraviglioso. Ciò nonostante, voi umani seguite questa dura dottrina, anche se in misura molto minore dei Vi."

units.id: mission:Giaru Gegno: Quarg Contact|	"The pursuit of technology leaves behind many values important to a glorious species' growth, that of which we have seen plentifully."|375|0
units.english: "The pursuit of technology leaves behind many values important to a glorious species' growth, that of which we have seen plentifully."
units.italian: "La ricerca della tecnologia lascia indietro molti valori importanti per la crescita di una specie gloriosa, e ne abbiamo visti parecchi."

units.id: mission:Giaru Gegno: Quarg Contact|	"Regrettably, most Gegno do not have a drive to pursue their principal future, diluting themselves far into their stagnant present. Segregation of followings was one of few ways to seek motivation beyond the fact."|378|0
units.english: "Regrettably, most Gegno do not have a drive to pursue their principal future, diluting themselves far into their stagnant present. Segregation of followings was one of few ways to seek motivation beyond the fact."
units.italian: "Purtroppo ai più dei Gegno manca la spinta a perseguire il loro futuro principale, e si diluiscono nel loro presente stagnante. La separazione delle correnti è stata uno dei pochi modi per cercare motivazione oltre questo fatto."

units.id: mission:Giaru Gegno: Quarg Contact|label|379|0
units.english: wrap up
units.italian: wrap up

units.id: mission:Giaru Gegno: Quarg Contact|	"Thank you for the information."|381|0
units.english: "Thank you for the information."
units.italian: "Grazie per le informazioni."

units.id: mission:Giaru Gegno: Quarg Contact|	"It seems that you do not like the paths they've chosen."|383|0
units.english: "It seems that you do not like the paths they've chosen."
units.italian: "Sembra che non vi piacciano i cammini che hanno scelto."

units.id: mission:Giaru Gegno: Quarg Contact|	The Quarg stands up, but as it does so, you watch as a few marks on its otherwise gray skin shift into blue hues with faint traces of purple, though they fade away shortly after. "It is not in our prosperous grasp to persuade the Gegno, as once we did attempt to. They threaten conflict with us should we interfere, and we have no desire to witness an imperiled uprising of such a sort once more." It pauses for an extended time, then gestures you to stand up as well.|384|0
units.english: The Quarg stands up, but as it does so, you watch as a few marks on its otherwise gray skin shift into blue hues with faint traces of purple, though they fade away shortly after. "It is not in our prosperous grasp to persuade the Gegno, as once we did attempt to. They threaten conflict with us should we interfere, and we have no desire to witness an imperiled uprising of such a sort once more." It pauses for an extended time, then gestures you to stand up as well.
units.italian: Il Quarg si alza e, mentre lo fa, vedi alcune macchie sulla sua pelle altrimenti grigia virare verso tonalità blu con deboli tracce di viola, che però svaniscono poco dopo. "Non è nella nostra prospera capacità persuadere i Gegno, perché un tempo ci abbiamo provato. Minacciano conflitto se interferiamo, e non desideriamo assistere di nuovo a una simile sommossa in pericolo." Resta in silenzio a lungo, poi ti fa cenno di alzarti anche tu.

units.id: mission:Giaru Gegno: Quarg Contact|	"Similarly, the Gegno do not wish to interact with audacious outsiders. Unfortunately, only a brief history of them we can tell. We cannot advocate virtuous pleasantries between you and them, though you are welcome at this ring should you find yourself here again. Please keep encounters with the Gegno minimal."|389|0
units.english: "Similarly, the Gegno do not wish to interact with audacious outsiders. Unfortunately, only a brief history of them we can tell. We cannot advocate virtuous pleasantries between you and them, though you are welcome at this ring should you find yourself here again. Please keep encounters with the Gegno minimal."
units.italian: "Allo stesso modo, i Gegno non desiderano interagire con audaci estranei. Purtroppo solo una breve storia possiamo raccontare di loro. Non possiamo caldeggiare cortesi convenevoli tra te e loro, ma sei il benvenuto su questo anello se ti ritroverai qui. Per favore, mantieni al minimo gli incontri con i Gegno."

units.id: mission:Giaru Gegno: Quarg Contact|label|392|0
units.english: interacted with outsider
units.italian: interacted with outsider

units.id: mission:Giaru Gegno: Quarg Contact|	"However, it is still quite staggering that the Gegno interacted with an audacious outsider such as yourself." The Quarg pauses again for a moment and takes a longer breath than usual. "Please do be distinctly cautious in encounters with the Gegno. Unfortunately, we cannot advocate virtuous pleasantries between you and them. Only a brief history of them can we tell. Although, you are appreciably welcome at this ring should you find yourself here again."|393|0
units.english: "However, it is still quite staggering that the Gegno interacted with an audacious outsider such as yourself." The Quarg pauses again for a moment and takes a longer breath than usual. "Please do be distinctly cautious in encounters with the Gegno. Unfortunately, we cannot advocate virtuous pleasantries between you and them. Only a brief history of them can we tell. Although, you are appreciably welcome at this ring should you find yourself here again."
units.italian: "Tuttavia è ancora sconcertante che i Gegno abbiano interagito con un audace estraneo come te." Il Quarg si ferma di nuovo un momento e prende un respiro più lungo del solito. "Ti prego di essere decisamente prudente negli incontri con i Gegno. Purtroppo non possiamo caldeggiare cortesi convenevoli tra te e loro. Solo una breve storia possiamo raccontare di loro. Però sei senz'altro il benvenuto su questo anello se ti ritroverai qui."

units.id: mission:Giaru Gegno: Quarg Contact|	The Quarg motions a bow to you, and the first one from earlier escorts you out of the room. It seems associating with these so-called "Gegno" would be difficult, and you will have to deal with their xenophobia for the foreseeable future.|396|0
units.english: The Quarg motions a bow to you, and the first one from earlier escorts you out of the room. It seems associating with these so-called "Gegno" would be difficult, and you will have to deal with their xenophobia for the foreseeable future.
units.italian: Il Quarg accenna un inchino e il primo di prima ti accompagna fuori dalla stanza. Sembra che avere a che fare con questi sedicenti "Gegno" sarà difficile, e dovrai convivere con la loro xenofobia nel prossimo futuro.

units.id: mission:Gegno Quarg Direction to Ringworld|name|401|0
units.english: Visit Quarg Ringworld
units.italian: Visita l'anello dei Quarg

units.id: mission:Gegno Quarg Direction to Ringworld|As soon as you land on this Quarg world, a few Quarg swiftly make their way to your ship. One of them stands in front of the rest and beckons you over while the others quietly speak to themselves in a language you've not heard before. The Quarg bows down slightly to speak to you, and judging by the look in its eyes, they seem rather perplexed. "Sdii veebyi keies Gegnion?" it asks, which seems to be the language the others were speaking in. Afterwards, it patiently waits for your response.|411|0
units.english: As soon as you land on this Quarg world, a few Quarg swiftly make their way to your ship. One of them stands in front of the rest and beckons you over while the others quietly speak to themselves in a language you've not heard before. The Quarg bows down slightly to speak to you, and judging by the look in its eyes, they seem rather perplexed. "Sdii veebyi keies Gegnion?" it asks, which seems to be the language the others were speaking in. Afterwards, it patiently waits for your response.
units.italian: Appena atterri su questo mondo Quarg, alcuni Quarg si dirigono in fretta verso la tua nave. Uno si mette davanti agli altri e ti fa cenno di avvicinarti, mentre gli altri parlano piano tra loro in una lingua che non hai mai sentito. Il Quarg si china appena per parlarti e, a giudicare dallo sguardo, sembra piuttosto perplesso. "Sdii veebyi keies Gegnion?" chiede, e sembra la lingua che parlavano gli altri. Poi aspetta con pazienza la tua risposta.

units.id: mission:Gegno Quarg Direction to Ringworld|	(Try to speak to the Quarg.)|413|0
units.english: (Try to speak to the Quarg.)
units.italian: (Prova a parlare con il Quarg.)

units.id: mission:Gegno Quarg Direction to Ringworld|	You introduce yourself to the Quarg and then explain that you don't understand their language. It lifts itself back up slowly, seemingly pondering the situation before turning back to the others. After a few more exchanged words, one of the other Quarg walk off and fetch some sort of device, bringing it back to you. It appears to be some type of holographic map. The Quarg gestures to a system nearby, which then reveals a hologram of a Quarg Ringworld. "Ehsveet Duebyuarr Giaru, Aechman," it says, and then bows before you.|414|0
units.english: You introduce yourself to the Quarg and then explain that you don't understand their language. It lifts itself back up slowly, seemingly pondering the situation before turning back to the others. After a few more exchanged words, one of the other Quarg walk off and fetch some sort of device, bringing it back to you. It appears to be some type of holographic map. The Quarg gestures to a system nearby, which then reveals a hologram of a Quarg Ringworld. "Ehsveet Duebyuarr Giaru, Aechman," it says, and then bows before you.
units.italian: Ti presenti al Quarg e spieghi che non capisci la sua lingua. Si raddrizza lentamente, sembra soppesare la situazione e poi si rivolge agli altri. Dopo qualche altra parola scambiata, uno degli altri Quarg si allontana e va a prendere una sorta di dispositivo, portandotelo. Sembra una specie di mappa olografica. Il Quarg indica un sistema vicino, che rivela un ologramma di un anello dei Quarg. "Ehsveet Duebyuarr Giaru, Aechman", dice, e poi si inchina davanti a te.

units.id: mission:Gegno Quarg Direction to Ringworld|	You should probably go pay the ringworld a visit.|415|0
units.english: You should probably go pay the ringworld a visit.
units.italian: Probabilmente dovresti andare a visitare quell'anello.

units.id: mission:Giaru Gegno: Revisit|You arrive once more at Giaru Gegno, hoping to find another Quarg that speaks your language. This time, however, you notice that a few of the Gegno on this ringworld occasionally give you a look of interest as they walk by. After about a minute of this a pair of Quarg approach you, motioning you to follow them. Led back to the familiar room from before, the Quarg you previously spoke with is already calmly sitting at the other end of the table.|429|0
units.english: You arrive once more at Giaru Gegno, hoping to find another Quarg that speaks your language. This time, however, you notice that a few of the Gegno on this ringworld occasionally give you a look of interest as they walk by. After about a minute of this a pair of Quarg approach you, motioning you to follow them. Led back to the familiar room from before, the Quarg you previously spoke with is already calmly sitting at the other end of the table.
units.italian: Arrivi di nuovo a Giaru Gegno, sperando di trovare un altro Quarg che parli la tua lingua. Stavolta però noti che alcuni Gegno dell'anello, passando, ti lanciano ogni tanto un'occhiata interessata. Dopo circa un minuto una coppia di Quarg ti si avvicina e ti fa cenno di seguirli. Riportato nella stanza di prima, trovi il Quarg con cui avevi parlato già seduto con calma all'altro capo del tavolo.

units.id: mission:Giaru Gegno: Revisit|	"You have astonishingly achieved a wondrous feat, brave traverser," the Quarg says, placing its hands together. It seems the Quarg are already aware of your encounter on the alien homeworld. In fact, thinking back to it, the looks of interest you received earlier suggests that the word spread quickly. "Not significantly often it is the mighty Gegno interact with daring outsiders."|430|0
units.english: "You have astonishingly achieved a wondrous feat, brave traverser," the Quarg says, placing its hands together. It seems the Quarg are already aware of your encounter on the alien homeworld. In fact, thinking back to it, the looks of interest you received earlier suggests that the word spread quickly. "Not significantly often it is the mighty Gegno interact with daring outsiders."
units.italian: "Hai compiuto in modo sorprendente un'impresa meravigliosa, coraggioso viaggiatore", dice il Quarg, unendo le mani. Sembra che i Quarg siano già al corrente del tuo incontro sul mondo natale alieno. Ripensandoci, le occhiate interessate che hai ricevuto prima suggeriscono che la notizia si sia sparsa in fretta. "Non è con frequenza significativa che i possenti Gegno interagiscono con audaci estranei."

units.id: mission:Giaru Gegno: Revisit|	"It was a coincidence."|432|0
units.english: "It was a coincidence."
units.italian: "È stata una coincidenza."

units.id: mission:Giaru Gegno: Revisit|	"They seemed in trouble when I found them, so I helped them."|433|0
units.english: "They seemed in trouble when I found them, so I helped them."
units.italian: "Sembravano in difficoltà quando li ho trovati, quindi li ho aiutati."

units.id: mission:Giaru Gegno: Revisit|	"Indeed yes, strange coincidences do curiously happen. Many coincidences are as mere fleeting moments of subtle peculiarity." The Quarg then displays a soft grimace. "Sometimes, one may be grand and powerful, in addition to having potent consequences. The Gegno have learned this a great number of times.|435|0
units.english: "Indeed yes, strange coincidences do curiously happen. Many coincidences are as mere fleeting moments of subtle peculiarity." The Quarg then displays a soft grimace. "Sometimes, one may be grand and powerful, in addition to having potent consequences. The Gegno have learned this a great number of times.
units.italian: "Certo, le coincidenze strane accadono in modo curioso. Molte coincidenze sono solo fugaci momenti di sottile stranezza." Il Quarg accenna a un'espressione cupa. "A volte una può essere grande e potente, oltre ad avere conseguenze notevoli. I Gegno l'hanno imparato un gran numero di volte.

units.id: mission:Giaru Gegno: Revisit|label|436|0
units.english: trouble
units.italian: trouble

units.id: mission:Giaru Gegno: Revisit|	"Quite a brave one you indeed are. Most would think to not leap into the daunting face of uncertainty as you have." The Quarg momentarily meditates on its next thought. "Though, as the Gegno have throughout their history, some may make momentous jumps undeterred by any amount of hesitance."|437|0
units.english: "Quite a brave one you indeed are. Most would think to not leap into the daunting face of uncertainty as you have." The Quarg momentarily meditates on its next thought. "Though, as the Gegno have throughout their history, some may make momentous jumps undeterred by any amount of hesitance."
units.italian: "Sei davvero uno coraggioso. Ai più non verrebbe in mente di saltare in faccia all'incertezza come hai fatto tu." Il Quarg medita per un momento sul pensiero successivo. "Però, come i Gegno hanno fatto nel corso della loro storia, alcuni compiono salti memorabili senza lasciarsi fermare da alcuna esitazione."

units.id: mission:Giaru Gegno: Revisit|	The Quarg raises from its seat, and you act in accordance. "Please do be distinctly cautious in your encounters with the Gegno. Always feel gracious to visit here once more, should you mindfully choose to do so." As you are directed out of the room, you turn back to see the Quarg bowing. You can't help but wonder what was on its mind during the conversation, but it might be for the best you are more careful from now on.|441|0
units.english: The Quarg raises from its seat, and you act in accordance. "Please do be distinctly cautious in your encounters with the Gegno. Always feel gracious to visit here once more, should you mindfully choose to do so." As you are directed out of the room, you turn back to see the Quarg bowing. You can't help but wonder what was on its mind during the conversation, but it might be for the best you are more careful from now on.
units.italian: Il Quarg si alza e tu fai lo stesso. "Ti prego di essere decisamente prudente nei tuoi incontri con i Gegno. Sentiti sempre gradito di tornare qui, se sceglierai di farlo con attenzione." Mentre ti accompagna fuori dalla stanza ti volti e vedi il Quarg che si inchina. Non puoi fare a meno di chiederti cosa avesse in mente durante la conversazione, ma forse è meglio se d'ora in poi sei più prudente.

units.id: mission:Suspicious Scin|name|466|0
units.english: Strange Device
units.italian: Dispositivo strano

units.id: mission:Suspicious Scin|description|467|0
units.english: A strange Gegno device suddenly appeared on your ship, displaying coordinates to a planet within Gegno space. Visiting the planet might lead to some answers, or perhaps something else.
units.italian: Un strano dispositivo Gegno è apparso all'improvviso sulla tua nave, mostrando le coordinate di un pianeta nello spazio Gegno. Visitarlo potrebbe dare qualche risposta, o forse qualcos'altro.

units.id: mission:Suspicious Scin|While you are going about your business, a faint signal starts emanating from somewhere in your ship. You aren't sure what it is, as it doesn't appear to originate from the ship itself, so you decide to take a look. After a few minutes of searching for the culprit, you come across a small device not too dissimilar from the one that was given to you by the Gegno you met on Var Oti, arbitrarily shoved into a corner of your ship's infrastructure. You don't know how or when it got there, but it doesn't appear to be dangerous.|480|0
units.english: While you are going about your business, a faint signal starts emanating from somewhere in your ship. You aren't sure what it is, as it doesn't appear to originate from the ship itself, so you decide to take a look. After a few minutes of searching for the culprit, you come across a small device not too dissimilar from the one that was given to you by the Gegno you met on Var Oti, arbitrarily shoved into a corner of your ship's infrastructure. You don't know how or when it got there, but it doesn't appear to be dangerous.
units.italian: Mentre te ne stai andando per i fatti tuoi, un debole segnale comincia a emanare da qualche parte della nave. Non sai cosa sia, perché non sembra provenire dalla nave stessa, così decidi di dare un'occhiata. Dopo qualche minuto di ricerca trovi un piccolo dispositivo non troppo diverso da quello che ti avevano dato i Gegno incontrati su Var Oti, ficcato lì per lì in un angolo delle strutture della nave. Non sai come o quando ci sia finito, ma non sembra pericoloso.

units.id: mission:Suspicious Scin|	Aside from the strange signal it's emitting, all the device appears to be doing is pointing to the location of a planet within Gegno space. The only option, aside from ignoring the device, is to visit this planet and see if there are any answers to this strange situation.|481|0
units.english: Aside from the strange signal it's emitting, all the device appears to be doing is pointing to the location of a planet within Gegno space. The only option, aside from ignoring the device, is to visit this planet and see if there are any answers to this strange situation.
units.italian: A parte lo strano segnale che emette, il dispositivo sembra solo indicare la posizione di un pianeta nello spazio Gegno. L'unica opzione, a parte ignorarlo, è visitare quel pianeta e vedere se ci sono risposte a questa strana situazione.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Scin|Led here by the mysterious device on your ship, you descend to the surface of this world, going through several thick layers of clouds. Once you break though them and prepare to land, you notice what appear to be a few Gegno Scin ships grounded nearby, easily distinguished by their various green color patterns. Two of them look like military vessels you've seen in nearby systems, while a third one between them is a small shuttlecraft. The Scin must be responsible for the device, seemingly expecting you as one of their warships begins to lift off the ground and head in your direction.|506|0
units.english: Led here by the mysterious device on your ship, you descend to the surface of this world, going through several thick layers of clouds. Once you break though them and prepare to land, you notice what appear to be a few Gegno Scin ships grounded nearby, easily distinguished by their various green color patterns. Two of them look like military vessels you've seen in nearby systems, while a third one between them is a small shuttlecraft. The Scin must be responsible for the device, seemingly expecting you as one of their warships begins to lift off the ground and head in your direction.
units.italian: Guidato dal misterioso dispositivo della nave, scendi verso la superficie di questo mondo attraversando diversi strati spessi di nuvole. Appena li sfondi e ti prepari ad atterrare, noti alcune navi dei Gegno Scin posate lì vicino, facilmente riconoscibili dai loro motivi verdi. Due sembrano vascelli militari che hai visto nei sistemi vicini, mentre un terzo, in mezzo, è un piccolo shuttle. Gli Scin devono essere responsabili del dispositivo, e sembrano aspettarti: una delle loro navi da guerra comincia a sollevarsi da terra e a dirigersi verso di te.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Scin|	(Leave the planet.)|508|0
units.english: (Leave the planet.)
units.italian: (Lascia il pianeta.)

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Scin|	(Wait and see what they do.)|510|0
units.english: (Wait and see what they do.)
units.italian: (Aspetta e vedi cosa fanno.)

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Scin|	(Prepare for combat.)|512|0
units.english: (Prepare for combat.)
units.italian: (Preparati al combattimento.)

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Scin|	Engaging your weapon systems, you brace yourself for a hostile encounter as they approach. The Scin ship advances towards yours then slowly comes to a halt in front of you. They haven't fired any weapons, and they aren't displaying any aggressive behavior, so they might not be looking for conflict. Ever so slightly, the warship reverses backwards and comes to a stop. You decide to stop your ship as well, and you wonder what this is about. Once again, the Scin ship reverses, slowly drifting away from you. It appears they want you to follow them.|513|0
units.english: Engaging your weapon systems, you brace yourself for a hostile encounter as they approach. The Scin ship advances towards yours then slowly comes to a halt in front of you. They haven't fired any weapons, and they aren't displaying any aggressive behavior, so they might not be looking for conflict. Ever so slightly, the warship reverses backwards and comes to a stop. You decide to stop your ship as well, and you wonder what this is about. Once again, the Scin ship reverses, slowly drifting away from you. It appears they want you to follow them.
units.italian: Attivi i sistemi d'arma e ti prepari a un incontro ostile mentre si avvicinano. La nave Scin avanza verso la tua e si ferma lentamente davanti a te. Non ha sparato e non mostra comportamenti aggressivi, quindi forse non cerca uno scontro. Appena appena, la nave da guerra indietreggia e si ferma. Decidi di fermare anche la tua e ti chiedi cosa significhi. La nave Scin indietreggia di nuovo, allontanandosi piano. Sembra che vogliano che tu li segua.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Scin|	Bringing your ship to a halt, you decide to wait and see what the Scin ship does as it advances towards you. As it slowly approaches, it slows down and eventually stops for a brief moment. Ever so slightly, the warship then begins to reverse backwards, and continues to drift away from you while facing you. They don't seem to be cautious of you, rather, it's almost as if they're implying to follow them.|517|0
units.english: Bringing your ship to a halt, you decide to wait and see what the Scin ship does as it advances towards you. As it slowly approaches, it slows down and eventually stops for a brief moment. Ever so slightly, the warship then begins to reverse backwards, and continues to drift away from you while facing you. They don't seem to be cautious of you, rather, it's almost as if they're implying to follow them.
units.italian: Fermata la nave, decidi di aspettare e vedere cosa fa la nave Scin mentre avanza. Si avvicina lentamente, rallenta e alla fine si ferma per un breve momento. Poi, appena appena, la nave da guerra comincia a indietreggiare e continua ad allontanarsi restando rivolta verso di te. Non sembrano diffidenti: è quasi come se ti stessero suggerendo di seguirli.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Scin|	(Follow them.)|522|0
units.english: (Follow them.)
units.italian: (Seguili.)

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Scin|	(Leave.)|524|0
units.english: (Leave.)
units.italian: (Vattene.)

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Scin|label|526|0
units.english: leave
units.italian: leave

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Scin|	Wary of the Scin warship, you turn around and begin to ascend back into space. The Scin ship advances towards yours, but as it comes closer, it begins to take on an escort formation with you, following you as you leave the planet's atmosphere. You're unsure of what they're doing on the planet or why you've been led to them, but maybe it's better for you to be careful and not get involved.|529|0
units.english: Wary of the Scin warship, you turn around and begin to ascend back into space. The Scin ship advances towards yours, but as it comes closer, it begins to take on an escort formation with you, following you as you leave the planet's atmosphere. You're unsure of what they're doing on the planet or why you've been led to them, but maybe it's better for you to be careful and not get involved.
units.italian: Diffidente verso la nave da guerra Scin, ti giri e cominci a risalire nello spazio. La nave Scin avanza verso la tua ma, avvicinandosi, assume una formazione di scorta e ti segue mentre lasci l'atmosfera del pianeta. Non sai cosa stiano facendo sul pianeta né perché ti abbiano portato da loro, ma forse è meglio essere prudente e non immischiarsi.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Scin|label|532|0
units.english: follow
units.italian: follow

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Scin|	You inch your ship forward in acknowledgment. All of a sudden, the second warship on the ground lifts off and forms up behind you, while the one in front of you turns around and begins to fly off into the distance. You follow them, curious where they might be leading you. To your rear, the remaining shuttle takes off, but instead of following you, it heads off into the atmosphere above.|535|0
units.english: You inch your ship forward in acknowledgment. All of a sudden, the second warship on the ground lifts off and forms up behind you, while the one in front of you turns around and begins to fly off into the distance. You follow them, curious where they might be leading you. To your rear, the remaining shuttle takes off, but instead of following you, it heads off into the atmosphere above.
units.italian: Sposti la nave in avanti di poco, in segno di assenso. All'improvviso la seconda nave da guerra a terra decolla e si mette in formazione dietro di te, mentre quella davanti si gira e comincia ad allontanarsi in volo. Li segui, curioso di dove ti stiano portando. Dietro di te lo shuttle rimasto decolla, ma invece di seguirti si dirige verso l'alto, nell'atmosfera.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Scin|	Although this planet initially appeared dull due to the several layers of thick clouds, the surface shows occasional signs of life such as plains of grass or dried-up riverbeds, while patches of low fog cover various other locations. As the flight continues, the two Scin ships slowly start to move around so that one is on either side of you. Up ahead in the distance, a large structure comes into view from behind another wall of fog. After getting a bit closer to it, you make out the familiar green colors of the ships flying with you now. The two warships begin to descend towards what you assume to be a sizable Scin freighter sitting in a large open area of sand.|536|0
units.english: Although this planet initially appeared dull due to the several layers of thick clouds, the surface shows occasional signs of life such as plains of grass or dried-up riverbeds, while patches of low fog cover various other locations. As the flight continues, the two Scin ships slowly start to move around so that one is on either side of you. Up ahead in the distance, a large structure comes into view from behind another wall of fog. After getting a bit closer to it, you make out the familiar green colors of the ships flying with you now. The two warships begin to descend towards what you assume to be a sizable Scin freighter sitting in a large open area of sand.
units.italian: Per quanto il pianeta sembrasse all'inizio monotono a causa dei vari strati di nuvole spesse, la superficie mostra ogni tanto segni di vita, come pianure erbose o letti di fiumi in secca, mentre banchi di nebbia bassa coprono altre zone. Mentre il volo continua, le due navi Scin cominciano lentamente a spostarsi così che una sia su ciascun lato. Più avanti, in lontananza, una grande struttura emerge da dietro un altro muro di nebbia. Avvicinandoti un po', distingui i familiari colori verdi delle navi che ora volano con te. Le due navi da guerra cominciano a scendere verso quello che supponi essere un grosso mercantile Scin posato in una vasta area di sabbia.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Scin|	Your previous encounter with a Vi warrior was chaotic and unpredictable, so it might be best to be extra cautious in this situation. As you set your ship down near the vessel, the two warships that guided you here also land nearby and power down. Other than the Gegno ships in front of you, there doesn't seem to be any strange activity on your radar at the moment. Environmental readings of the outside surprisingly indicate conditions safe for a human, but it's better to be safe than sorry. You equip your environment suit and your pistol just in case.|537|0
units.english: Your previous encounter with a Vi warrior was chaotic and unpredictable, so it might be best to be extra cautious in this situation. As you set your ship down near the vessel, the two warships that guided you here also land nearby and power down. Other than the Gegno ships in front of you, there doesn't seem to be any strange activity on your radar at the moment. Environmental readings of the outside surprisingly indicate conditions safe for a human, but it's better to be safe than sorry. You equip your environment suit and your pistol just in case.
units.italian: Il tuo precedente incontro con un guerriero Vi è stato caotico e imprevedibile, quindi in questa situazione è meglio essere molto prudenti. Mentre posi la nave vicino al mercantile, le due navi da guerra che ti hanno guidato atterrano anche loro lì vicino e si spengono. A parte le navi Gegno davanti a te, al momento il radar non mostra attività strane. Le letture ambientali esterne indicano sorprendentemente condizioni sicure per un umano, ma è meglio non rischiare. Indossi la tuta ambientale e prendi la pistola, per sicurezza.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Scin|	(Approach the Scin.)|539|0
units.english: (Approach the Scin.)
units.italian: (Avvicinati agli Scin.)

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Scin|	(Stay by my ship.)|541|0
units.english: (Stay by my ship.)
units.italian: (Resta vicino alla mia nave.)

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Scin|	You take one or two steps forward but remain close by your ship, staying alert. The freighter is indeed large - maybe four times the size of a Hauler, or almost twice the size of a Behemoth. An elevator lowers from its undercarriage, and a group of Scin exit the ship, making their way towards you. Their attire is much different than that of the Vi; most of them are wearing what looks like segmented armor with many layers of plates, giving the appearance of scales. One of them, however, has a much lighter armor set focused mainly around their shoulders, with orange robe-like garments underneath. They are slightly thinner than the other Scin. Although they are nowhere near as bulky as the Vi, they all still appear taller than any human. More importantly, they seem far more eager to interact with you, seeing as they left the comfort of their own ship to greet you.|542|0
units.english: You take one or two steps forward but remain close by your ship, staying alert. The freighter is indeed large - maybe four times the size of a Hauler, or almost twice the size of a Behemoth. An elevator lowers from its undercarriage, and a group of Scin exit the ship, making their way towards you. Their attire is much different than that of the Vi; most of them are wearing what looks like segmented armor with many layers of plates, giving the appearance of scales. One of them, however, has a much lighter armor set focused mainly around their shoulders, with orange robe-like garments underneath. They are slightly thinner than the other Scin. Although they are nowhere near as bulky as the Vi, they all still appear taller than any human. More importantly, they seem far more eager to interact with you, seeing as they left the comfort of their own ship to greet you.
units.italian: Fai uno o due passi in avanti ma resti vicino alla nave, in allerta. Il mercantile è davvero grande: forse quattro volte un Hauler, o quasi due volte un Behemoth. Dal sottoscocca scende un ascensore e un gruppo di Scin esce dalla nave e si dirige verso di te. Il loro abbigliamento è molto diverso da quello dei Vi: i più indossano quella che sembra un'armatura segmentata a molti strati di piastre, che dà l'aspetto di squame. Uno di loro però ha un'armatura molto più leggera, concentrata soprattutto sulle spalle, con indumenti arancioni simili a vesti sotto. È un po' più esile degli altri Scin. Per quanto non siano neanche lontanamente massicci come i Vi, sembrano comunque tutti più alti di qualsiasi umano. Soprattutto, sembrano molto più desiderosi di interagire: hanno lasciato la comodità della loro nave per venirti incontro.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Scin|	Stopping about four meters from you, the Scin in heavier armor drop to the ground on one knee. The one wearing a robe takes a few more steps, then sits on the ground in front you, crossing their legs.|543|0
units.english: Stopping about four meters from you, the Scin in heavier armor drop to the ground on one knee. The one wearing a robe takes a few more steps, then sits on the ground in front you, crossing their legs.
units.italian: Fermandosi a circa quattro metri da te, gli Scin con l'armatura più pesante si inginocchiano a terra. Quello con la veste fa qualche passo in più e poi si siede a terra davanti a te, a gambe incrociate.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Scin|	(Sit down.)|545|0
units.english: (Sit down.)
units.italian: (Siediti.)

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Scin|	(Reach for my pistol.)|547|0
units.english: (Reach for my pistol.)
units.italian: (Allunga la mano verso la pistola.)

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Scin|label|549|0
units.english: sit
units.italian: sit

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Scin|	You sit down, taking a good look at them. Their skin appears almost bone-like with very faint patterns of light green. Unlike the Vi, they have three small horns and barely any hair at all. They seem just as interested in your appearance, looking you up and down. Another Scin from the freighter walks over, bringing some sort of device and kneeling down next to the robed one, who takes the device and sets it down between you and them. It looks like some sort of tablet or drawing implement.|550|0
units.english: You sit down, taking a good look at them. Their skin appears almost bone-like with very faint patterns of light green. Unlike the Vi, they have three small horns and barely any hair at all. They seem just as interested in your appearance, looking you up and down. Another Scin from the freighter walks over, bringing some sort of device and kneeling down next to the robed one, who takes the device and sets it down between you and them. It looks like some sort of tablet or drawing implement.
units.italian: Ti siedi e li osservi bene. La pelle sembra quasi ossea, con debolissimi motivi verde chiaro. A differenza dei Vi hanno tre piccole corna e quasi nessun pelo. Sembrano altrettanto interessati al tuo aspetto e ti squadrano. Un altro Scin del mercantile si avvicina con una sorta di dispositivo e si inginocchia accanto a quello con la veste, che prende l'oggetto e lo posa tra voi due. Sembra una specie di tavoletta o di strumento per disegnare.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Scin|	The Scin then reaches their palm out and makes a mark on one half of the display, then turns it to you.|551|0
units.english: The Scin then reaches their palm out and makes a mark on one half of the display, then turns it to you.
units.italian: Lo Scin tende allora il palmo e traccia un segno su metà dello schermo, poi lo gira verso di te.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Scin|	(Place my hand on the device.)|553|0
units.english: (Place my hand on the device.)
units.italian: (Appoggia la mano sul dispositivo.)

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Scin|	(Do nothing.)|554|0
units.english: (Do nothing.)
units.italian: (Non fare nulla.)

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Scin|	Placing your own palm on the device, you feel it vibrate a little. A detailed wireframe of your hand appears on the other half of the device. The Scin moves the device aside, then extends one arm out showing the top of their hand.|556|0
units.english: Placing your own palm on the device, you feel it vibrate a little. A detailed wireframe of your hand appears on the other half of the device. The Scin moves the device aside, then extends one arm out showing the top of their hand.
units.italian: Appoggi il palmo sul dispositivo e lo senti vibrare un poco. Sull'altra metà appare una struttura dettagliata della tua mano. Lo Scin sposta il dispositivo e allunga un braccio mostrando il dorso della mano.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Scin|	(Extend my arm as well.)|558|0
units.english: (Extend my arm as well.)
units.italian: (Allunga il braccio anche tu.)

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Scin|	(Do nothing.)|559|0
units.english: (Do nothing.)
units.italian: (Non fare nulla.)

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Scin|	Reaching with your right hand, the Scin leans forward and carefully examines it, then makes another note on their device. After writing down a few more things, they get up from the ground and gesture strangely towards you, crossing their arms together to form a plus sign toward their left. The other heavier-armored Scin rise from their stances and begin heading back to their ships, and the one in front of you follows behind them.|563|0
units.english: Reaching with your right hand, the Scin leans forward and carefully examines it, then makes another note on their device. After writing down a few more things, they get up from the ground and gesture strangely towards you, crossing their arms together to form a plus sign toward their left. The other heavier-armored Scin rise from their stances and begin heading back to their ships, and the one in front of you follows behind them.
units.italian: Allunghi la mano destra: lo Scin si sporge, la esamina con cura e prende un'altra nota sul dispositivo. Dopo aver scritto qualche altra cosa, si alza da terra e fa verso di te uno strano gesto, incrociando le braccia a formare un segno più rivolto alla propria sinistra. Gli altri Scin con l'armatura pesante si alzano e cominciano a tornare alle loro navi, e quello davanti a te li segue.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Scin|	You return to your own ship after the bewildering encounter, wondering what to make of it, and the Scin do not follow you any further.|564|0
units.english: You return to your own ship after the bewildering encounter, wondering what to make of it, and the Scin do not follow you any further.
units.italian: Torni alla tua nave dopo lo sconcertante incontro, chiedendoti cosa pensarne, e gli Scin non ti seguono oltre.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Scin|label|567|0
units.english: imagery
units.italian: imagery

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Scin|	Turning the device back around, the Scin types some sort of note on it then clears the display. They then begin to draw some sort of picture with one of their fingers. The finished image appears to be a portrait of themselves. "Dueyu Scin," they speak in a low tone. Clearing the image, they draw something that looks like you, albeit a bit out of proportion, then await some sort of answer.|568|0
units.english: Turning the device back around, the Scin types some sort of note on it then clears the display. They then begin to draw some sort of picture with one of their fingers. The finished image appears to be a portrait of themselves. "Dueyu Scin," they speak in a low tone. Clearing the image, they draw something that looks like you, albeit a bit out of proportion, then await some sort of answer.
units.italian: Girando di nuovo il dispositivo, lo Scin digita una sorta di nota e poi pulisce lo schermo. Poi comincia a disegnare con un dito. L'immagine finita sembra un ritratto di sé. "Dueyu Scin", dice a voce bassa. Cancellata l'immagine, ne disegna una che somiglia a te, anche se un po' sproporzionata, e aspetta una qualche risposta.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Scin|	"Dueyu human..?"|570|0
units.english: "Dueyu human..?"
units.italian: "Dueyu human..?"

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Scin|	"I am human."|571|0
units.english: "I am human."
units.italian: "Sono umano."

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Scin|	(Say nothing.)|572|0
units.english: (Say nothing.)
units.italian: (Non dire nulla.)

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Scin|	The Scin looks at you in what you guess to be fascination. They grab the device and draw yet another picture. After setting it down, you recognize the familiar image of a Gegno Vi warrior.|574|0
units.english: The Scin looks at you in what you guess to be fascination. They grab the device and draw yet another picture. After setting it down, you recognize the familiar image of a Gegno Vi warrior.
units.italian: Lo Scin ti guarda con quella che supponi essere fascinazione. Prende il dispositivo e disegna un'altra immagine. Dopo averlo posato, riconosci la figura familiare di un guerriero Gegno Vi.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Scin|	"Gegno Vi?"|576|0
units.english: "Gegno Vi?"
units.italian: "Gegno Vi?"

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Scin|	"Dueyu Vi?"|577|0
units.english: "Dueyu Vi?"
units.italian: "Dueyu Vi?"

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Scin|	Looking at you with a confused expression, they draw another portrait that looks like the shorter leather-wearing Gegno from their homeworld, and move that image together with the images of the Vi and the Scin. "Gegno," they say, and begin to think to themselves. A brief moment passes, and they begin drawing on the device again. After they turn it back to you, you see both a green-colored patch and a brown-colored patch. "Vi," the Scin says, pointing to the brown. "Scin," they say, now pointing to the green. Afterwards, they point to the group of the three Gegno portraits. "Gegno."|580|0
units.english: Looking at you with a confused expression, they draw another portrait that looks like the shorter leather-wearing Gegno from their homeworld, and move that image together with the images of the Vi and the Scin. "Gegno," they say, and begin to think to themselves. A brief moment passes, and they begin drawing on the device again. After they turn it back to you, you see both a green-colored patch and a brown-colored patch. "Vi," the Scin says, pointing to the brown. "Scin," they say, now pointing to the green. Afterwards, they point to the group of the three Gegno portraits. "Gegno."
units.italian: Guardandoti con un'espressione confusa, disegnano un altro ritratto che somiglia al Gegno più basso e vestito di cuoio del loro mondo natale, e accostano quell'immagine a quelle del Vi e dello Scin. "Gegno", dicono, e cominciano a riflettere. Passa un breve momento e riprendono a disegnare sul dispositivo. Dopo averlo girato verso di te, vedi una macchia verde e una macchia marrone. "Vi", dice lo Scin indicando il marrone. "Scin", dice, indicando ora il verde. Poi indica il gruppo dei tre ritratti Gegno. "Gegno."

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Scin|	Once they mark down a few more notes, they get up from the ground and begin heading back to their ships. The heavier-armored Scin also rise from their stances and follow behind them.|581|0
units.english: Once they mark down a few more notes, they get up from the ground and begin heading back to their ships. The heavier-armored Scin also rise from their stances and follow behind them.
units.italian: Dopo aver preso qualche altra nota, si alzano da terra e cominciano a tornare alle loro navi. Anche gli Scin con l'armatura pesante si alzano e li seguono.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Scin|	All of a sudden, a gust of sand rushes past from behind you, and you turn around to see three more armored Scin rising from the sand, one of them fairly close to you. Their armor is much different than that of the others, characterized by darker shades, sharper edges, and several gadgets, but what is most notable is their possession of sickle-like blade weapons. It appears the Scin had more control of the situation than you thought, and had you made the wrong choice in the encounter, it's possible you would be on the receiving end of one of those blades.|582|0
units.english: All of a sudden, a gust of sand rushes past from behind you, and you turn around to see three more armored Scin rising from the sand, one of them fairly close to you. Their armor is much different than that of the others, characterized by darker shades, sharper edges, and several gadgets, but what is most notable is their possession of sickle-like blade weapons. It appears the Scin had more control of the situation than you thought, and had you made the wrong choice in the encounter, it's possible you would be on the receiving end of one of those blades.
units.italian: All'improvviso una raffica di sabbia ti passa alle spalle e, voltandoti, vedi altri tre Scin corazzati che si alzano dalla sabbia, uno dei quali piuttosto vicino a te. La loro armatura è molto diversa da quella degli altri: tonalità più scure, bordi più affilati e diversi aggeggi, ma la cosa più notevole è che portano armi a lama a forma di falce. A quanto pare gli Scin avevano più controllo della situazione di quanto pensassi, e se avessi fatto la scelta sbagliata nell'incontro, forse ora saresti dalla parte sbagliata di una di quelle lame.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Scin|	You return to your ship and take off from the planet, but the Scin do not follow you any further.|583|0
units.english: You return to your ship and take off from the planet, but the Scin do not follow you any further.
units.italian: Torni alla nave e decolli dal pianeta, ma gli Scin non ti seguono oltre.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Scin|label|586|0
units.english: quiet
units.italian: quiet

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Scin|	They stare at you for a few seconds, then retrieve their device. The Scin sits up more rigidly, giving you a deep look, then tilts their head to the right, followed by an awkward silence.|587|0
units.english: They stare at you for a few seconds, then retrieve their device. The Scin sits up more rigidly, giving you a deep look, then tilts their head to the right, followed by an awkward silence.
units.italian: Ti fissano per qualche secondo, poi ritirano il dispositivo. Lo Scin si raddrizza, ti lancia uno sguardo profondo e inclina la testa a destra, seguito da un silenzio imbarazzante.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Scin|	(Tilt my head to the right as well.)|589|0
units.english: (Tilt my head to the right as well.)
units.italian: (Inclina la testa a destra anche tu.)

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Scin|	(Tilt my head to the left.)|590|0
units.english: (Tilt my head to the left.)
units.italian: (Inclina la testa a sinistra.)

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Scin|	(Do nothing.)|591|0
units.english: (Do nothing.)
units.italian: (Non fare nulla.)

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Scin|	Once you tilt your head, they note down your behavior on the device. Subsequently, they get up from the ground and begin heading back to their ships. The heavier-armored Scin also rise from their stances and follow behind them.|593|0
units.english: Once you tilt your head, they note down your behavior on the device. Subsequently, they get up from the ground and begin heading back to their ships. The heavier-armored Scin also rise from their stances and follow behind them.
units.italian: Quando inclini la testa, annotano il tuo comportamento sul dispositivo. Poi si alzano da terra e cominciano a tornare alle loro navi. Anche gli Scin con l'armatura pesante si alzano e li seguono.

units.italian: Torni alla nave e decolli dal pianeta, ma gli Scin non ti seguono oltre.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Scin|label|598|0
units.english: no thoughts
units.italian: no thoughts

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Scin|	The Scin stares at you for an uncomfortable length of time, then sighs. They reach into their armor and pull out a small firearm, raising it at you.|599|0
units.english: The Scin stares at you for an uncomfortable length of time, then sighs. They reach into their armor and pull out a small firearm, raising it at you.
units.italian: Lo Scin ti fissa per un tempo imbarazzante, poi sospira. Fruga nell'armatura e tira fuori una piccola arma da fuoco, puntandotela contro.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Scin|	(Reach for my firearm.)|601|0
units.english: (Reach for my firearm.)
units.italian: (Allunga la mano verso l'arma.)

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Scin|	(Raise my arms.)|602|0
units.english: (Raise my arms.)
units.italian: (Alza le braccia.)
